points.statement: The work targets an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration.
points.quote: We aim to build an efficient and effective model for medical image restoration based on the Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV)

points.statement: A newly designed block serves as the basic component for extracting features.
points.quote: we present a novel R-RWKV block as its fundamental component for feature extraction

points.statement: Modifications adapt the block to capture global and local dependencies in spatial images.
points.quote: we incorporate two innovations in the R-RWKV block to adapt it for capturing global and local dependencies in 2D images

points.statement: An attention mechanism builds global dependencies across spatial images with linear computational complexity.
points.quote: we introduce a recurrent WKV (Re-WKV) attention mechanism that effectively builds global dependencies in 2D images with linear computational complexity

points.statement: A shift mechanism captures local context from all directions to improve performance.
points.quote: we introduce an omnidirectional token shift mechanism that accurately captures local context to enhance the model performance
